definitions.explanation: The act of going to a foreign country for educational purposes.

examples.japanese: アメリカに{留学|りゅうがく}したい。
examples.english: I want to study abroad in America.

examples.japanese: {留学|りゅうがく}{経験|けいけん}は{貴重|きちょう}だ。
{留学|りゅうがく}{生|せい}として{日本|にほん}に{来|き}た。
examples.english: I came to Japan as an international student.

notes:
USAGE: {留学|りゅうがく} specifically refers to studying abroad for educational purposes, usually for an extended period.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{留学|りゅうがく}する (to study abroad)
・{留学|りゅうがく}に{行|い}く (to go study abroad)
・{留学|りゅうがく}{生|せい} (international student)
・{留学|りゅうがく}{先|さき} (study abroad destination)
・{交換|こうかん}{留学|りゅうがく} (exchange study)
・{短期|たんき}{留学|りゅうがく} (short-term study abroad)

RELATED:
・{留学|りゅうがく}{生|せい} - international student
・{帰国|きこく}{子女|しじょ} - returnee (child who lived abroad)
